title: The Pocket Power Stack: forecast, files, and shell

intro.headline: Ad-free weather, a real file manager, and a Linux terminal in your pocket.
intro.subhead: Breezy Weather, Material Files, and Termux replace Google's weather, Files by Google, and the laptop you drag around for a shell.

outro.headline: Three stock-app swaps that earn their place.
outro.subhead: No ads, no trackers, no telemetry — just the weather, your files, and a shell that does what you tell it.
